name: Westchester Summer Day
description_short: Day camp of Westchester Day School on Long Island Sound in Mamaroneck for children from age 3 to 8th grade, rooted in Jewish values, with swim, beach, a ropes course, sports, arts, cooking and music. Campers in 5th to 8th grade pick an active or creative track each week and take day and overnight trips. Kosher lunch and snacks are included; busing costs extra.

sessions.name: Full summer, full day (pre-nursery 3s to 8th grade)

notes: 2027 standard full day rates: 5 weeks $6,250, 6 weeks $6,650, 7 weeks $6,900, full summer $7,100. Westchester Day School students pay less ($5,500 to $6,400). Half day for 3 year olds $5,250 to $6,100. The full summer session runs June 28 to August 18; shorter options are chosen within it.
